'''2010 Worlds Day 2 Ben Brummett DS Endor Operations''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Ben Brummett]] at [[2010 World Championship]] (Day 2).

Sheet deck name '''Endor ops'''. Defensive Shields section lists 10 cards (as written).

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' [[Endor Operations / Imperial Outpost|Endor Operations / Imperial Outpost (V)]]
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 2
